spell.diaithir_druidry.thornlash.name: Boildidielg
spell.diaithir_druidry.thornlash.descrip: Flings a barbed vine at a foe: {damage} nature damage and a short slow.
spell.diaithir_druidry.dewdrop.name: Driùchdu
spell.diaithir_druidry.dewdrop.descripti: A bead of cool dew heals the one you look at (yourself if none): {heal} health.
spell.diaithir_druidry.briar_snare.name: Ribidries
spell.diaithir_druidry.briar_snare.descr: Briars burst from the ground at the target spot and hold anything in them: slow and light damage each pulse.
spell.diaithir_druidry.oakskin.name: Kraikenddaurach
spell.diaithir_druidry.oakskin.descripti: Your skin takes on oak bark for 12 seconds: resistance, at the cost of slowness.
spell.diaithir_druidry.grove_mending.des: A ring of green light heals you and every ally close by, and leaves a slow regrowth.
spell.diaithir_druidry.stag_leap.name: Leimdaum
spell.diaithir_druidry.stag_leap.descrip: You bound forward and up like a stag and take no damage from the fall that follows.
spell.diaithir_druidry.mistletoe_spear.d: Hold to draw a white-berried spear of pith and thorn. A full draw pierces two foes and poisons them.
item.diaithir_druidry.spell_book/druid.s: The grove-keepers. They mend the hurt and bind the loud with root and thorn. Heals and plant control.
spell.diaithir_druidry.sight_spark.name: Sraudagsieldad
spell.diaithir_druidry.sight_spark.descr: A bright flicker that stings for {damage} and leaves the target outlined for 6 seconds.
spell.diaithir_druidry.far_sight.name: Fradurk
spell.diaithir_druidry.far_sight.descrip: Your eyes open to the dark for 40 seconds: night vision.
spell.diaithir_druidry.fate_thread.name: Snàddànu
spell.diaithir_druidry.fate_thread.descr: You pull on the target's thread: it is weakened and slowed for 8 seconds and takes {damage}.
spell.diaithir_druidry.veil_step.name: Keimskàili
spell.diaithir_druidry.veil_step.descrip: You step through the veil and appear 8 blocks ahead.
spell.diaithir_druidry.salmon_knowing.de: Channel for 2.5 seconds: a stream of bright knowing cuts through everything in a line.
spell.diaithir_druidry.watch_hour.name: Fairi
spell.diaithir_druidry.watch_hour.descri: Everything hostile within 14 blocks glows for 10 seconds, even behind stone.
spell.diaithir_druidry.foretold_blow.des: You name a place and the blow falls there a heartbeat later: {damage} to everything in 3 blocks.
item.diaithir_druidry.spell_book/ovate.s: The seers. They see what is hidden and strike where a blow is already foretold. Sight, marks and blinks.
spell.diaithir_druidry.sharp_note.name: Bilegtàirnenach
spell.diaithir_druidry.sharp_note.descri: One struck note travels as a crackle and does {damage}.
spell.diaithir_druidry.lullaby.name: Tàlad
spell.diaithir_druidry.lullaby.descripti: The target's limbs go heavy: slowness and weakness for 6 seconds, and it forgets its hurry.
spell.diaithir_druidry.lament.name: Kuma
spell.diaithir_druidry.lament.descriptio: A long falling strain: nearby foes stagger back and are struck by dread: nausea for 4 seconds.
spell.diaithir_druidry.laughter.name: Gàiri
spell.diaithir_druidry.laughter.descript: A bright strain mends you and each ally near you for {heal} and quickens them for 4 seconds.
spell.diaithir_druidry.horn_cry.name: Adurkglaed
spell.diaithir_druidry.horn_cry.descript: A great horn blast hammers the area in front of you: {damage} and a heavy shove.
spell.diaithir_druidry.banner_song.name: Òrunbrautach
spell.diaithir_druidry.banner_song.descr: A marching song for 15 seconds: you and nearby allies gain speed and haste.
spell.diaithir_druidry.storm_chord.name: Koseirmstoirmi
spell.diaithir_druidry.storm_chord.descr: Hold a chord for 3 seconds. The sky answers along your aim and each moment of the chord strikes.
item.diaithir_druidry.spell_book/bard.sp: The singers. Three strains (sleep, lament, laughter) and their thunder. Crowd control and rally.
spell.diaithir_druidry.verse_blow.name: Boildirand
spell.diaithir_druidry.verse_blow.descri: A hard line of verse flies out: {damage} and a short weakness.
spell.diaithir_druidry.ward_verse.name: Randskiad
spell.diaithir_druidry.ward_verse.descri: A spoken ward gives you a shield of 3 extra hearts for 20 seconds.
spell.diaithir_druidry.satire.name: Aeiri
spell.diaithir_druidry.satire.descriptio: A cutting rhyme raises blisters on the proud: slowness, weakness and {damage} to the target.
spell.diaithir_druidry.truth_word.name: Fìrind
spell.diaithir_druidry.truth_word.descri: A true word spoken over you and your allies strips slowing and harmful effects and heals {heal}.
spell.diaithir_druidry.hundred_verses.de: A rapid recital: five small bolts fan out in a spread, each doing {damage}.
spell.diaithir_druidry.ban_oath.name: Toirmesk
spell.diaithir_druidry.ban_oath.descript: You lay a ban on the target: withering for 5 seconds and hunger for 15.
spell.diaithir_druidry.curse_pall.name: Maldachd
spell.diaithir_druidry.curse_pall.descri: A dark cloud of ill words settles on the target ground for 7 seconds and keeps cursing what stands in it.
item.diaithir_druidry.spell_book/filid.s: The poets of law and satire. Their words wound, bind and shield. Curses, wards and cleansing.
spell.diaithir_druidry.crow_strike.name: Boildifiendag
spell.diaithir_druidry.crow_strike.descr: Two quick strikes, like a crow at carrion. Each hits for {damage}.
spell.diaithir_druidry.battle_cry.name: Glaedkad
spell.diaithir_druidry.battle_cry.descri: A raven-throated shout: you and allies near you gain strength for 10 seconds.
spell.diaithir_druidry.raven_leap.name: Leimfitech
spell.diaithir_druidry.raven_leap.descri: You throw yourself forward in a low leap with a speed burst.
spell.diaithir_druidry.battle_fury.name: Bàinid
spell.diaithir_druidry.battle_fury.descr: You fall into fury for 8 seconds: strong blows, but you take more harm (weaker defence).
spell.diaithir_druidry.talon_wheel.name: Roudspoiri
spell.diaithir_druidry.talon_wheel.descr: A full spin: three sweeping cuts that hit everything around you for {damage} each.
spell.diaithir_druidry.field_terror.name: Oildti
spell.diaithir_druidry.field_terror.desc: Dread shakes nearby foes: they are shoved back and weakened for 6 seconds.
spell.diaithir_druidry.ford_washer.name: Àdbàsu
spell.diaithir_druidry.ford_washer.descr: A single heavy stroke. Foes under a third of their health take triple damage.
The war-crow's way. Short sharp melee strikes, battle shouts and fear. Scales with melee power.
spell.diaithir_druidry.fairy_mist.name: Kietach
spell.diaithir_druidry.fairy_mist.descri: A cold white mist rises where you point: it clings, slows and nips for 6 seconds.
spell.diaithir_druidry.glamour_veil.name: Loindskàili
spell.diaithir_druidry.glamour_veil.desc: A veil of glamour: you are unseen for 6 seconds and quick for 3.
spell.diaithir_druidry.hill_step.name: Keimknok
spell.diaithir_druidry.hill_step.descrip: You step inside the hill and out again 12 blocks ahead.
spell.diaithir_druidry.folk_gift.name: Tiudlak
spell.diaithir_druidry.folk_gift.descrip: A gift from the hill: the target regains {heal} health over 10 seconds, and is lightly shielded.
spell.diaithir_druidry.silver_branch.des: A bright branch flies out and passes through two foes. Each is chilled and takes {damage}.
spell.diaithir_druidry.folk_hour.name: Uoirsìtichi
spell.diaithir_druidry.folk_hour.descrip: Time thickens around you: foes within 7 blocks crawl for 3 seconds and are nipped by frost.
spell.diaithir_druidry.hail_fall.name: Klachmelduin
spell.diaithir_druidry.hail_fall.descrip: A hail of stones falls around the target spot: {damage} to each foe struck, with a chill.
item.diaithir_druidry.spell_book/sidhe.s: The hollow-hill folk. Mist, glamour and gifts that come with a price. Control and mobility.
spell.diaithir_druidry.forge_spark.name: Sraudag
spell.diaithir_druidry.forge_spark.descr: A spark spits from the fire: {damage} and burning for 3 seconds.
spell.diaithir_druidry.quench.name: Kaisk
spell.diaithir_druidry.quench.descriptio: You plunge your hands in the quench-trough: fire resistance for 40 seconds and any fire on you goes out.
spell.diaithir_druidry.hot_iron.name: Iarnaigitied
spell.diaithir_druidry.hot_iron.descript: Hold to heat the iron. A full draw hurls a white-hot bolt that does {damage} and sets the foe alight.
spell.diaithir_druidry.tempering.name: Kaisiiarnaigi
spell.diaithir_druidry.tempering.descrip: You temper your body for 10 seconds: haste, strength and resistance, then a short tiredness.
spell.diaithir_druidry.slag_cloud.name: Skòdsaliaruind
spell.diaithir_druidry.slag_cloud.descri: A cloud of hot slag settles at the target spot for 6 seconds and keeps burning what stands in it.
spell.diaithir_druidry.forge_breath.name: Anuilkum
spell.diaithir_druidry.forge_breath.desc: Channel the bellows for 2.5 seconds: a lance of heat along your aim, burning all it crosses.
spell.diaithir_druidry.molten_rain.name: Oiskiliegti
spell.diaithir_druidry.molten_rain.descr: A rain of molten iron falls around the target spot: {damage} to each drop's blast and burning.
item.diaithir_druidry.spell_book/smith.s: The forge-masters. Fire from the hearth: sparks, hot iron and the long pour. Damage over time and self-tempering.
